# arena-skill (third-party notice)

Source: https://github.com/Jakeschincariol/arena-skill
Author: Jake Schincariol
License: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this directory)

This project does not copy arena-skill source code. It adapts the repository's
four sub-agent role definitions (competitor, attacker, defender, judge) and
their policy-spec format into four deterministic simulator bots in
`simulator/arena_bots.py`, as requested for the arena sessions. The four policy
specs were authored for that exercise and are summarised in
`docs/ARENA_INTEGRATION.md`.

The MIT copyright and permission notice above is reproduced in full to satisfy
the license's attribution requirement for these adapted concepts.
